# Support in development

Giotto Suite support for **Atera** data is currently in development.

This page is a placeholder so the platform appears in the Examples menu. It
will be replaced with a full tutorial — object creation, pre-processing and a
worked analysis — following the same structure as the other technology
examples.

## In the meantime

If you have Atera data and want to try Giotto Suite now, the generic object
constructors will usually get you started:

- [Giotto object creation](object_creation.html) — building an object from
  expression, spatial and image inputs directly
- [Technology-specific importers](import_utilities.html) — the readers that
  already exist for other platforms, which are a useful template

## Get in touch

If you are working with this platform we would like to hear from you — an
example dataset is the fastest route to first-class support.

- [Open a discussion](https://github.com/giotto-suite/Giotto/discussions)
- [Report an issue](https://github.com/giotto-suite/Giotto/issues)
